text:
sara-partners: Kickoff for Evergreen Labs marketplace onboarding (AWS/GCP/Azure). We need clear owners for: cloud IAM/KMS examples, contract addendum (rotation + audit access), SKU manifest, staging screenshots, and launch comms. Quick volunteers?

 tom-cloud: I can do the cloud artifacts (AWS AssumeRole sample, GCP SA impersonation, Azure role assign). Will post examples by Tue.

 lee-legal: I'll draft the marketplace addendum. Evergreen requested explicit customer-managed key language and a 90-day rotation clause. Need SKU strings to reference.

 nora-product: I'll own SKU naming and trial packaging. Proposing ids: ["evergreen-core", "evergreen-dedicated", "evergreen-trial"]. Will upload a CSV to the doc.

 ash-ops: Trials need metadata: duration, seat cap, auto-expire. Also confirm support level text and telemetry consent. Who confirms telemetry?

 sara-partners: Partner confirmed anonymized telemetry share. Support contact will be marketplace-support@redwood.com.

 tom-cloud: AWS AssumeRole example to include in templates:
 ```json
 {
   "Version": "2012-10-17",
   "Statement": [
     {
       "Effect": "Allow",
       "Action": ["sts:AssumeRole"],
       "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::PARTNER_ACCOUNT:role/EvergreenPublisher"
     }
   ]
 }
 ```

 tom-cloud: GCP impersonate (gcloud) snippet:
 ```bash
 gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding evergreen-sa@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
   --member='serviceAccount:publisher@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \
   --role='roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator'
 ```

 tom-cloud: Azure role assignment (az cli):
 ```bash
 az role assignment create --assignee-object-id <PUBLISHER_ID> --role "Contributor" --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>
 ```

 rui-eng: I'll build the staging demo and take screenshots once the manifest lands. Please drop the exact SKU CSV so I can bake them into the publisher manifest.

 lee-legal: If SKU IDs arrive by Mon I'll aim to finish addendum by Thu COB. Will include KMS rotation and a 30-day audit log access window.

 ci-bot: New doc created: /docs/marketplace/evergreen-manifest-draft.md

 nora-product: CSV uploaded with SKU ids. Final: ["evergreen-core","evergreen-dedicated","evergreen-trial"] and billing units documented.

 ash-ops: Added trial metadata and support email to the manifest.

 sara-partners: Great. Next sync Thurs 10am PT to review legal + staging pass and confirm webinar date. Action items: @tom-cloud -> IAM templates; @nora-product -> finalize CSV; @lee-legal -> addendum draft; @rui-eng -> staging assets. :thumbsup:
